map.二维码活动追踪：在落地页 URL 上拼接 UTM 参数（utm_source /: QR campaign tracking: append UTM parameters (utm_source / medium / campaign / term / content) to the landing page URL to produce a standard trackable link.
map.不同渠道（朋友圈/公众号/线下）各放一个码追踪扫码量。: Use a separate code per channel (Moments / official account / offline) to track scan volume.
map.对比各码扫码与后续转化看渠道效果。: Compare scans and downstream conversions per code to judge channel performance.
map.活动结束汇总各码数据做复盘。: Aggregate the data from every code when the campaign ends for a review.
map.3 个码分别投朋友圈/公众号/线下海报，活动期扫码 1200/800/300，朋: Three codes placed in Moments, the official account and an offline poster recorded 1200 / 800 / 300 scans during the campaign, so Moments contributed the most; if the official account converts better, shift budget there next time.
map.线下码扫码 300 但到店转化 60（20%），朋友圈 1200 扫码仅转化 1: The offline code drew 300 scans with 60 store visits converting (20%), while Moments drew 1200 scans with only 120 converting (10%): offline is smaller but higher quality.
map.一个活动为什么用多个码？: Why use several codes for one campaign?
map.同活动多码可归因各渠道独立表现，避免把所有流量混在一起无法优化。: Multiple codes let each channel's performance be attributed separately, instead of mixing all traffic together with no way to optimize.
map.扫码量低就是码不行？: Does low scan volume mean the code is bad?
map.不一定，受曝光位置与激励影响，应结合「曝光×扫码率」看，而非只看绝对数。: Not necessarily; it depends on placement and incentive, so look at exposure × scan rate rather than the absolute number.
